about: Real footage tier. Each clip is fetched from Wikimedia Commons and verified against the pinned SHA-1; no footage is stored in this repo. Licenses are per clip (CC BY / CC BY-SA need attribution: see source.credit and source.page). Labels follow taxonomy.json; flaws: [] means good form that should be praised, not corrected.

clips.description: High-school All-American forward shooting a game free throw, filmed upright on a phone from the stands, facing the shooter.
clips.label_notes: Clean, repeatable free throw: knees load, ball rises in line, high release and a held follow-through. No coachable flaw visible.

clips.description: Kobe Bryant shooting a free throw during Lakers warmups, handheld fan video from the baseline stands; other players are in frame.
clips.label_notes: Elite NBA shooter, textbook mechanics; should get praise, not fixes. Several players in frame also tests shooter selection.

clips.description: Pro centre Marianna Tolo shooting a game free throw (Open LFB 2014), filmed from high in the stands (wide, small subject).
clips.label_notes: Professional free throw with no coachable flaw visible; small subject tests robustness to distance.

clips.description: Trained player demonstrating a two-legged above-head jump shot for a published shot-type study; static camera roughly side-on.
clips.label_notes: Competitive-level jump shot: leg drive, high set point, release near the top of the jump, held follow-through. No flaw labeled.
